findings.what: Reference circuit fully implemented - all checklist items present
Using 33Ω series resistors instead of 27Ω (documented deviation - 27Ω not available in JLCPCB Basic parts)
Using USBLC6-4SC6 instead of USBLC6-2SC6 (quad-channel version, compatible)
TYPE-C-31-M-12 connector pin names (A6, B6, A7, B7, SH1, SH2) assumed from USB-C standard - MUST verify against actual symbol after import
USBLC6-4SC6 SOT-23-6 pinout documented in code comments - pins 1,6 for D+, pins 3,4 for D-, pin 2 GND, pin 5 VCC
All power and ground connections present: +3V3 (USB_VDD decoupling), GND (shield, ESD protection)
USB shield properly grounded through ferrite bead (FB1) and 1MΩ resistor (R3) in parallel
Voltage compatibility verified: All signals at 3.3V logic level, compatible with RP2040 USB PHY
ESD protection VCC connected to +3V3 (correct clamp voltage for 3.3V USB signals)
Port directions correct: USB_DP and USB_DM are bidirectional, match interface.json
Signal flow correct: Connector → ESD protection → series resistor → RP2040
No critical items missing - all required USB interface components present
CC pins (A5, B5) correctly left unconnected (device-only mode, no USB PD)

manual_verification_required: Verify TYPE-C-31-M-12 imported symbol pin names match code (A6, B6, A7, B7, A1, A12, B1, B12, SH1, SH2)
Verify USBLC6-4SC6-ES imported symbol pin numbers match code (1-6 in SOT-23-6)
Confirm ferrite bead polarity (should be non-polarized, but verify symbol)
Verify all LCSC numbers match parts.json entries

topology_summary.signal_path: USB-C connector → ESD protection (USBLC6-4SC6) → 33Ω series resistors → RP2040 pins 47/46
topology_summary.ground: USB shield → ferrite bead || 1MΩ resistor → GND
topology_summary.protection: Bi-directional ESD clamping on D+/D- lines

deviations_from_reference.justification: 27Ω not available in JLCPCB Basic parts, 33Ω within acceptable 22-33Ω range per RP2040 datasheet
Quad-channel version available in JLCPCB catalog, electrically compatible, provides same protection
